name: opcua-mqtt-bridge
description: OPC UA to MQTT bridge for CONNECT-MES contract

scripts.obfuscate: javascript-obfuscator build/backend.bundle.js --output build/backend.protected.js --compact true --self-defending false --string-array true --string-array-encoding rc4
scripts.release: npm run bundle:server && npm run prepare:native && npm run obfuscate && npm run stage:dist && npm run compile
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run bundle:server && npm run obfuscate && node scripts/package/stage-dist.js --target=host && cd dist-server && pkg .
